findings: The r-band Zenodo archive MD5 and member CRC match; Info-ZIP produced a full stream with 109,971,576 rows and zero malformed rows.
The r archive member central-directory 32-bit size value equals the streamed size modulo 2^32; this is a size-field representation issue, not evidence of a truncated stream.
The CDS ReadMe reports 89,697,393 r rows, while the sum of Table 2 Nr is 109,970,858 and the Zenodo r stream has 109,971,576 rows.
Seq 615172 is a strong cross-band identity lead for Table 2 Seq 615170, but no automatic SourceID remapping is accepted.
The 718-row archive-versus-Table2 Nr residual and the full per-Seq mismatch distribution remain open.
